notes.title: Update Notes 1.0.13
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.13:
-Various bug fixes and optimizations
-Added Enemy Movement highlight square for easier tracking
-Added Sprint In the Player controller
-Minor sprite fixes

Future Updates Planned:
-Revamp of the Chess UI 
-Gambling in the capital 
-Challenge in the capital to be able to infinitely play for cash to avoid soft-lock
-Potential for random position game mode (new game+)

Join the discord and your suggestions will be added!

notes.title: Chess, Texas Version 1.3.2
notes.notes:
Additions:

- Chess Set customization - unlock new chess set skins as you progress through the story 

- Get half money from draw

BugFix:

-Space was removed to interact with NPCS

-Resign on enemy turn made you win and get stuck

-Blank avatar assigned on chess hall 1

-Intro start repeated if you didn't beat the full intro sequence on load 

-Penalty money clipping in middle text sometimes

-UI explainer would show up again on load if not beaten the full intro

-Fixed a potential bug where player controller could slip out of the tile grid

-Could not castle in the position with Billy Sr

-Depending on your hardware some pieces could not be clicked sometimes. Replaced the pieces boxcollider2d with boxcollider
